high_level_description: This image captures a scene inside a car on a rainy day. The view is from the passenger seat, looking out through the rear window. The window is covered with raindrops, creating a textured pattern that obscures the view outside to some extent. Through the window, part of an airplane is visible, parked at what appears to be an airport gate. The airplane's body is white with some text and markings, though they are not entirely clear due to the rain and distance. The interior of the car is dimly lit, suggesting it might be early morning or late afternoon.
